paragraphs.zh: 环磺酮制备方法，其特征在于，包括如下的任意一个步骤：
paragraphs.en: A process for preparing tembotrione, characterised in that it comprises any one of the following steps:
paragraphs.notes: 环磺酮 is the Chinese common name of the herbicide tembotrione; translated as the common name, no structure for it is drawn on this page. The claim is followed directly by two drawn steps, labelled (v) and (v'). Section title above the claims is 权利要求书 (Claims).

paragraphs.zh: 根据权利要求1所述的方法，其中所述步骤(v)和(v′)分别为以下步骤：
paragraphs.en: The process according to claim 1, wherein said steps (v) and (v') are respectively the following steps:

paragraphs.zh: 根据权利要求2所述的方法，其中步骤(v-1)或(v′-1)的反应在贵金属催化剂和磷配体或其盐存在下进行，所述贵金属选自钯、铑、钌、铜、钴，优选钯催化剂，更优选氯化钯(PdCl2)、碳酸钯(PdCO3)、醋酸钯[Pd(OAc)2]、钯/碳(Pd/C)、三氟乙酸钯[Pd(OTFA)2]、双二亚苄基丙酮钯[Pd(dba)2]；
paragraphs.en: The process according to claim 2, wherein the reaction of step (v-1) or (v'-1) is carried out in the presence of a noble metal catalyst and a phosphine ligand or a salt thereof, said noble metal being selected from palladium, rhodium, ruthenium, copper, cobalt, preferably a palladium catalyst, more preferably palladium chloride (PdCl2), palladium carbonate (PdCO3), palladium acetate [Pd(OAc)2], palladium on carbon (Pd/C), palladium trifluoroacetate [Pd(OTFA)2], bis(dibenzylideneacetone)palladium [Pd(dba)2];
paragraphs.notes: Subscripts are printed as subscripts in the original (PdCl2, PdCO3, Pd(OAc)2, Pd(OTFA)2, Pd(dba)2) and are transcribed inline here. The list names 钯、铑、钌、铜、钴 (palladium, rhodium, ruthenium, copper, cobalt) as 贵金属 (noble metals) even though copper and cobalt are not noble metals; translated literally. 碳酸钯(PdCO3) is transcribed as printed; the formula PdCO3 as given is the patent's own text.

drawings.notes: Step label (v) printed to the right of the product. No reagents are written on this arrow; the arrow is drawn as a thin line with a solid arrowhead. Four consecutive substituted ring positions, the two unsubstituted CH between Br/COOH and SO2CH3.

structures.core: benzene ring bearing an ester carbonyl, esterified to a cyclohex-2-en-1-one ring at its enol carbon
substituents: ester O at cyclohexenone C1 (the alkene carbon)
C1=C2 double bond in the cyclohexenone ring
structures.name: 3-oxocyclohex-1-en-1-yl 2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoate

drawings.notes: Step label (v') printed to the right, below the product; a full-width 。 closes the claim after 式（VIII）. The arrow is drawn as a dotted/dashed line with a solid arrowhead. In the product the enol ester oxygen sits on the ring carbon carrying the C=C; the ketone is two carbons round the ring from it, so the ring is drawn as a 3-oxocyclohex-1-en-1-yl group.
This is the elaborated form of step (v); the step label (v-1) is printed to the right. H2O is written above the arrow and CO below it, as separate positions.

discrepancies.what: The catalyst and phosphine ligand required by claim 3 for steps (v-1) and (v'-1) are not drawn on any arrow.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Arrow for (v-1) carries only H2O above and CO below; arrow for (v'-1) carries only CO above.
discrepancies.text_says: [权利要求 3]: the reaction of step (v-1) or (v'-1) is carried out in the presence of a noble metal catalyst and a phosphine ligand or a salt thereof.

discrepancies.what: The claim 1 schemes carry no reagents at all, while the claim 2 schemes for the same two transformations do.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Claim 1 arrows (v) and (v') are bare; claim 2 arrows (v-1) and (v'-1) carry H2O/CO and CO.
discrepancies.text_says: [权利要求 2]: steps (v) and (v') are respectively the following steps, i.e. the claim 1 steps are the generic form of the claim 2 steps.

discrepancies.what: Cyclohexane-1,3-dione appears as an explicit reactant only in the claim 2 version of the step.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Scheme (v'-1) draws 式（IV） + cyclohexane-1,3-dione; scheme (v') draws 式（IV） alone.
discrepancies.text_says: Neither claim names cyclohexane-1,3-dione in prose; it appears only in the drawing.
